newsitem.title: USA: Electronic Retailing Systems in Brazil deal.
newsitem.headline: Electronic Retailing Systems in Brazil deal.

text.p: Electronic Retailing Systems International Inc said Friday it has an agreement for Sao Paolo-based Seal Eletronica Ltd to market the U.S. company's electronic shelf-labeling systems across Brazil.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Electronic Retailing Systems also said Seal Eletronica has arranged the first Brazilian order for its ShelfNet wireless labeling system. The system will be installed in one store of one of Brazil's largest food retailing chains, it said.

Seal Eletronica is the largest bar code and automatic data capture systems integrator in Brazil. It serves the retail, manufacturing and distribution, banking, transportation and documentation industries.

Electronic Retailing Systems is a leading developer and supplier of electronic shelf labeling systems. The company's ShelfNet system is designed to save costs and increase pricing accuracy by linking a store's central computer both to its checkout scanner and to the ShelfNet electronic liquid crystal display shelf labels at the shelf edge.
